Identity.Name: Pset_StingHealthcareClinical
Identity.Definition: STING healthcare clinical parameters — infection control, pressure regime, medical gas, anti-ligature, and radiation protection data. Written by the Healthcare Pack commands (H-1..H-30) and associated validators.

Governance.StandardsBasis: HTM 02-01 (medical gas); HBN series (room classes); HTM 04-01 (water hygiene); BS EN ISO 7396-1; NFPA 99 §5.1; NCRP 147; IPEM Report 75; BS 8300 (anti-ligature)

Property.name: CLN_ROOM_CLASS_TXT
Property.Definition: HBN / HTM room class code identifying the clinical function (e.g. SingleBedroom, TheatreMain, IsolationRoom, ICU).

Property.name: CLN_PRESSURE_PA
Property.Definition: Room pressure regime (Pa) relative to the adjacent corridor — positive for protective isolation, negative for source isolation.

Property.name: CLN_PRESSURE_REGIME_TXT
Property.Definition: Pressure regime classification: Positive / Negative / Neutral / Isolation (matched against HTM 03-01 and ASHRAE 170 tables).

Property.name: CLN_ACH
Property.Definition: Design air change rate (ACH — air changes per hour) for this clinical space.

Property.name: CLN_INFECTION_CONTROL_TXT
Property.Definition: Infection control zone classification: Standard / Enhanced / Protective / SourceIsolation / UltraClean.

Property.name: MGS_GAS_TYPE_TXT
Property.Definition: Medical gas type at this terminal unit or pipeline segment: O2 / N2O / MedAir / SurgAir / Vac / AGSS / CO2.

Property.name: MGS_FLOW_LS
Property.Definition: Medical gas design flow rate (L/s) at this outlet per NFPA 99 §5.1.13 / HTM 02-01 sizing tables.

Property.name: MGS_OUTLET_COUNT
Property.Definition: Number of terminal outlet units in this space or on this equipment item.

Property.name: MGS_SYSTEM_REF_TXT
Property.Definition: MGPS zone or pipeline system reference from the medical gas network graph (MgasNetwork).

Property.name: LIG_AREA_OBS_LOS_TXT
Property.Definition: Anti-ligature: observation / line-of-sight requirement for this area — DirectObservation / CCTV / Unobserved.

Property.name: LIG_ANCHOR_COMPLIANT_BOOL
Property.Definition: True when all ceiling and wall anchor points in this space are anti-ligature compliant per BS 8300 and Trust policy.

Property.name: RAD_LEAD_MM_NR
Property.Definition: Radiation shielding lead equivalent thickness (mm Pb) required for this wall, floor, or ceiling element.

Property.name: RAD_WORKLOAD_W_MBQ
Property.Definition: Radiation source workload (W · MBq) used in the NCRP 147 shielding calculation for this room.

Property.name: RAD_AREA_CLASSIFICATION_TXT
Property.Definition: NCRP 147 / IPEM radiation area classification: ControlledArea / SupervisedArea / UncontrolledArea / PublicArea.
